The Radeon HD 7600G IGP was a mobile integrated graphics solution by AMD, launched on September 1st, 2012. Built on the 32 nm process, and based on the Devastator-M graphics processor, the device supports DirectX 11.2. It features 384 shading units, 24 texture mapping units, and 8 ROPs. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 320 MHz, which can be boosted up to 424 MHz.
Its power draw is rated at 19 W maximum.
